name: Robust Material Graph Deduction
definition: A method to deduce a material graph G(M, I) from a set of disconnected interface edges Î, where M is the set of materials and I is the set of interfaces between adjacent materials. It solves the problem of manual transfer function creation by automatically discovering material interiors and spatial interconnectivity.
summary: Robust Material Graph Deduction automatically discovers material interiors and spatial interconnectivity to generate transfer functions by explicitly modeling adjacent material topology as a graph and optimizing for separation energy.
